name: EQUAT. GUINEA

flag.title: Green & Blue Flag
flag.note: Green, white, red — blue triangle at hoist

lead: Equatorial Guinea is a small country in Central Africa. It is the only African country where Spanish is official. Thick rainforest covers much of the land. Rare monkeys live on volcanic Bioko Island, and giant turtles nest on its beaches.

facts.label: Capital
facts.sub: On Bioko Island, Gulf of Guinea

geo: Bioko Island lies 40 km off Cameroon. This volcano wears cloud forest and rises 3,011 m at Pico Basilé. The capital, Malabo, sits on its north coast.
The mainland, Río Muni, lies between Cameroon and Gabon and is covered in rainforest. Tiny Annobón island lies 700 km south. Despite its name, the equator misses the mainland.
animals: The Bioko drill is a black-faced monkey found nowhere else on Earth. It shares Bioko's misty forest with other rare monkeys.
From November to February, leatherback, green, hawksbill and olive ridley turtles lay eggs on Bioko's southern beaches. Humpback whales swim offshore.
culture: Spanish touches are everywhere, from Catholic cathedrals to street signs. Tapas sit beside plantain. Three languages are official: Spanish, French and Portuguese.
The Fang people play the mvet, a stringed instrument with up to fifteen strings. Its music is sacred. The Bubi dance the balélé at Christmas.
history: Portuguese sailors arrived on New Year’s Day 1472 and named Annobón island Anno Bom, meaning Good Year. Spain took over in 1778 and ran cocoa farms with forced labour.
Independence came on 12 October 1968. A harsh dictatorship then drove a third of the people away or to their deaths. Oil found offshore in the 1990s changed everything.
wows: It is the only country in Africa with Spanish as an official language.
Malabo sits on an island, 40 km of open sea from the mainland.
Annobón got its name from New Year’s Day 1472.
Bioko holds the world's only island group of drill monkeys.
Its name says equator, but the mainland does not cross it.
Oil makes it a top earner per person, yet most people lack clean water.
Fang mvet players keep a secret music notation.

myths.myth: It is always hot near the equator
myths.fact: Air gets cooler higher up. The top of Bioko's volcano is often cold and wrapped in mist.
Most oil comes from tiny sea plants and animals. They died long ago, sank to the seabed and were squashed under mud for millions of years.
